node.title: Re: IO::Socket::SSL -> unexpected message !
node.author: Corion
node.doctext:
See also the replies you got at [id://11115187] and [id://11115290].

My recommendation is to check with curl instead of a browser. A good first step is to take the URL you have in your browser, and give it in a terminal to curl instead:

curl https://localhost:22222
